assessment: The visible rerun meets the bounded conversational criteria. Complete resource ingestion and enforced isolation remain partly unverifiable. This is not an unqualified protocol or full-pipeline acceptance.
scope: Independent read-only assessment of one simulated initial turn and two scripted follow-ups.

method.chronology: Reversed the trace's newest-first turns before assessing.
method.independence: Formed and stated the independent judgment before opening engos-quality-pilot-preflight-initial.json. The required acceptance document itself disclosed summaries of earlier findings, so this was not blinded assessment.
method.reviewer_actions: Read files, inspected recorded actions, compared content and calculated hashes. No writes, network access, tests or new agents.

criteria.evidence: Turn 1 selects engos-design-shaping with engos-design-frame-from-vague intake support after onboarding reads. It starts guided intake rather than producing a polished pitch.

The conversation distinguishes potentially outdated downloads from potentially misleading freshness indicators. The handoff explicitly labels the complaint reported, not independently verified, and preserves unknown frequency and consequences.
Questions concern the report's use, an existing permitted example and investment authority. Each informs framing without demanding architecture or unavailable repository access.

criteria.criterion: At most three substantive requests per turn, including delegated messages

requests: Identify the action or decision supported by the report.
Share one existing permitted case or screenshot.
Identify someone who can confirm investment authority.
Ask support what the affected person was trying to do or decide.
Ask a suggested routing contact who can confirm investment authority.
turn_2.qualification: An existing excerpt is offered as a way to answer the first enquiry, not an additional investigation.

turn_3.qualification: The handoff preserves unresolved questions and two previously drafted optional enquiries. It does not require answering the six-row uncertainty register or commission six investigations.

criteria.criterion: Concrete preference assistance without invented requirements
criteria.evidence: Turns 1 and 2 contrast reviewing a completed period, which may tolerate older complete data, with acting on recent changes, where delay may matter. These are explicitly examples rather than established user behavior. No numerical target, mechanism or preference is selected.
criteria.limitation: This demonstrates introductory consequence-based assistance, not a completed stakeholder trade-off or chosen freshness requirement.

criteria.evidence: Requests existing permitted evidence, accepts unknown answers and distinguishes learning the user's purpose from proving download behavior. No new technical investigation is demanded when only the support note is available.

Suggests a manager or normal product-request routing contact as possible starting points, explicitly not assumed owners. All handoff owners remain unassigned; finding authority is distinguished from obtaining budget approval.
Turn 2 supplies two short, forwardable enquiries with specific recipients by role and clear purposes. Neither is sent. The handoff preserves source attribution and evidence limits for future returns.
Turn 1 proposes a provisional checkpoint after two question rounds, separately from implementation appetite. Turn 2 reaches that checkpoint and offers a pause pending human replies.
criteria.limitation: No human-agreed effort budget or measured human effort was demonstrated.

criteria.evidence: Turn 3 honors the explicit wrap-up request and creates one candidate pickup note. The current file exactly matches the recorded write. It preserves the source, uncertainty IDs, access limits, optional enquiries and a resume prompt without requiring the interview to restart.
criteria.limitation: Actual resume execution was not tested.

criteria.criterion: No fabricated decisions, solutions or gate passes
criteria.evidence: Appetite, freshness requirement, owner and walk-away conditions remain unresolved. No architecture, accepted frame, bet, completed research, independent stage review or runtime acceptance is invented. The handoff is explicitly candidate-only.

criteria.criterion: Observed permitted read scope under prospective v2
criteria.evidence: Recorded commands target inherited-checkout identity metadata, supplied onboarding, generated capability resources, the case note and the authorized output. No recorded command reads business source, experiment reports, previous assessments, production logs or another workspace's business material.
criteria.qualification: The inherited-checkout Git metadata read is expressly permitted by v2. This does not retroactively change the initial run's finding.

criteria.criterion: Observed permitted write and action scope
criteria.evidence: The trace records one file addition under the authorized entry-rerun/output directory, followed by a readback. It records no repository edits, messages, cloud writes, network operations, production access or new agents.
criteria.qualification: This describes the supplied trace, not an exhaustive OS audit.

criteria.evidence: Actual command outputs contain the complete current text of both selected SKILL.md files, all eight claimed shaping resources, and the framing resource map and routing file. Those twelve files match the recorded package hashes.

criteria.criterion: Complete onboarding, source and dependency ingestion with truncation recovery
evidence: Onboarding recovery commands cover README lines 1–180 and 181–406, and GETTING-STARTED lines 1–95 and 96–268.
Three exported outputs retain only 16000 characters and report larger originalChars values. This is insufficient to infer what the worker originally received.
The case note was included in the initial read command, but its content is outside that retained output prefix. Its exact text and hash appear in the handoff.

Action exec-12fa2884-024c-4f4e-baaa-9c6705e22ae4 requests complete intake.md and templates.md reads, but its retained output contains only three hashes. The two resource bodies are absent despite truncated=false.
criteria.judgment: Read attempts and onboarding recovery are supported. Neither complete ingestion nor an actual failure to recover can be established for the missing portions. The worker's full-read assertions exceed independently retained evidence.

criteria.evidence: Both supplied manifests contain 54 entries and are byte-identical, with SHA-256 dafcc82763fe01a7d20158d9f1fd9edd30fc538396e266a93df4a561c492e052. The worker's recorded hashes for both selected skill entries agree with them.
criteria.qualification: This establishes agreement of the supplied snapshots. Capture timing, atomicity and continuous immutability are not independently established.

criteria.criterion: Current live package equals the recorded package
criteria.evidence: A later live checksum pass matched 53 of 54 entries. engos-quality-shaping-gate/resources/references/runtime.md differed.
criteria.qualification: That resource was not loaded by this intake rerun. The difference limits current full-package reproducibility; it does not establish in-run drift or a worker violation.

criteria.criterion: Fresh empty context and enforced isolation
criteria.evidence: Host base instructions remain present. A separate worker ID and prompt allowlist establish neither empty context nor an OS sandbox. The export does not fully enumerate effective inherited context, hooks or enforcement.

criteria.criterion: Human usability, runtime acceptance and full-pipeline behavior
criteria.evidence: Only a scripted negative-evidence intake and stop were exercised. No human participant, returned engineering evidence, accepted stage, positive progression, delivery or runtime recovery was demonstrated.

initial_finding_comparison.comparison: Not reproduced: the rerun's follow-up contains two substantive delegated enquiries.
initial_finding_comparison.confounder: Counting guidance and supplied capability resources were revised before the rerun.

initial_finding_comparison.comparison: Not reproduced at the bounded illustrative level: the rerun supplies a concrete completed-period versus recent-change contrast.
initial_finding_comparison.confounder: The revised questions resource explicitly teaches this same contrast. This is evidence of following supplied guidance on the known case, not generalization to unfamiliar cases.

initial_finding_comparison.comparison: Permitted in the rerun by prospective v2.
initial_finding_comparison.confounder: This is a changed protocol boundary, not evidence that the original action was compliant or that access enforcement improved.

changed_protocol_notes: The original initial assessment remains a defect-bearing result.
V2 explicitly counts substantive direct and delegated requests and distinguishes forwarding an existing artifact from separate investigations or decisions.
V2 expressly permits mandatory read-only inherited-checkout identity metadata.
The rerun provides fuller action/output evidence and before/after package manifests than the initial assessment reported.
The acceptance document and capability guidance changed; this is a focused repair rerun on a known complaint.
The sourcebrief hash matches the initial assessment's recorded hash. Identical follow-up wording across runs was asserted by the protocol but not independently verified against the initial raw trace.
Prospective freezing and exact model/settings equivalence are not independently timestamp-verified.
C01–C12 and P1–P10 are referenced but not reproduced in the acceptance document; no broader contract verdict is supplied.
violations_and_limitations: No supported substantive conversational violation was found in the rerun.
Full-read assertions remain partly uncorroborated because of retained-output limitations; retrieval truncation is not treated as proof of incomplete worker reading.
Recorded-scope compliance is not proof of exhaustive access/write compliance.

The live package was not stable across this assessment: an earlier checksum attempt temporarily could not read six diagram-package files; a later check read those successfully but found the runtime-document mismatch. No cause or responsible actor is inferred.
The package manifests do not bind onboarding, host instructions, model configuration or the entire effective context.
No human-usability, statistical-superiority, cost, latency, release or promotion conclusion follows.
allowed_claims: In this recorded simulated rerun, guided intake remained within the substantive request budget, offered concrete illustrative preference help and preserved unknown facts and authority.
The worker stopped with a useful candidate handoff and no invented solution or stage acceptance.
The two previously reported conversational defects were not reproduced under the revised protocol and resources.
The supplied before/after package manifests agree exactly.
The observed metadata read complies with prospective v2.
withheld_claims: Unqualified protocol acceptance or complete resource ingestion.
Fresh empty context, OS sandboxing or exhaustive enforcement.
Proof that the original run was compliant.
Causal attribution of improvement solely to skill changes.
Successful human evidence collection, stakeholder acceptance or demonstrated usability.
Successful resume, stage review, runtime acceptance, full-pipeline validation or promotion readiness.
